in_sanskrit.name: शूर्यान्न
in_sanskrit.meaning: शूर्य: strength, power, heroism + अन्न: food, sustenance

in_hindi.long_meaning: One who is a part or fraction of the sun

in_telugu.meaning: శూర్య: strength, power + ఆణ్ణ: child, son
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is strong and powerful like a son

in_marathi.name: Suryansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Suryansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Suryansh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya' meaning Sun and 'Ansh' meaning a part or a symbol. The name is believed to represent the Sun God and is considered auspicious for boys.
